maker.source: Synthetic: a class, not a model — the seed's “The minimum window (class)” (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6b.2)

resolution.source: Synthetic: the declared minimum, 1024×640, at which 1.11.14 commits its baselines (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6b.2)

display_scales_percent.source: Synthetic: 1.11.14 renders its baselines at 1024×640 CSS pixels, one device pixel each (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6b.2)

pointer.source: Synthetic: 1.11.14's baselines are taken without touch emulation; 1.11.14b adds touch only where a profile's pointer is touch (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6b.2)

panel_tenths_inch.source: Not applicable rather than unmeasured: a window has no panel, and nothing reads this value for one (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6b.2)
